// Blood II's AI classes and the constants a mod's Mod\AI.txt can set for
// them.  GENERATED by `testBlood2Tables --dump ai` from
// Blood2/ObjectDLL/BloodModAI.cpp and BloodModAIFields.h; do not edit,
// regenerate.
//
// A mod names only what it changes:
//
//     [CultistAI]
//     HitPoints = 60.0
//
// Each class's own values are its constructor's (CultistAI.cpp's
// CultistAI::CultistAI), not listed here: the classes are not a table.
// A mod with [Options] Trace = TRUE prints them, for each class the
// level creates.  A level's own property for the same member (the
// properties a class declares in its BEGIN_CLASS) still wins over the
// mod's value. Blood2/ObjectDLL/BloodModAI.h has the rest.

// The keys.  FLOAT and INT are 0 or more; a STR is at most 31 characters;
// a BOOL is TRUE or FALSE; FLAGS is a string of the names below joined by
// |, the whole word ("CRAWL | JUMP", "" for none).
//
//     HearingDist  FLOAT
//     SensingDist  FLOAT
//     SmellingDist  FLOAT
//     SeeingDist  FLOAT
//     WalkSpeed  FLOAT
//     RunSpeed  FLOAT
//     JumpSpeed  FLOAT
//     RollSpeed  FLOAT
//     Mass  FLOAT
//     HitPoints  FLOAT
//     RandomHitPoints  FLOAT
//     ArmorPoints  FLOAT
//     Strength  INT
//     AIState  STR
//     AIWeapon1  STR
//     AIWeapon2  STR
//     AIWeapon3  STR
//     AIWeapon4  STR
//     AIWeapon5  STR
//     Bullets  FLOAT
//     BMG  FLOAT
//     Shells  FLOAT
//     Grenades  FLOAT
//     Rockets  FLOAT
//     Flares  FLOAT
//     Cells  FLOAT
//     Charges  FLOAT
//     Fuel  FLOAT
//     Proximity_Bombs  FLOAT
//     Flags  FLAGS
//     Cabal  BOOL
//     BestWeapon  BOOL
//     ChaseRun  BOOL
//     ChaseNear  BOOL
//     AttackWeapon  STR
//     NoAltFire  STR
//     FadeMax  FLOAT
//     FadeMin  FLOAT
//     LoopVolume  INT
//     SpawnCooldown  FLOAT
//     SpawnInterval  FLOAT
//     SpawnAlways  BOOL
//     Script  BOOL
//     Robe  BOOL
//     DeathSkinNormal  PATH
//     DeathSkinFire  PATH
//     DeathSkinAcid  PATH
//     DeathSkinElectric  PATH
//     DeathSkinExplode  PATH
//     DeathSkinSingularity  PATH
//     DeathSkinMelee  PATH
//     DeathFXNormal  OBJFX
//     DeathFXFire  OBJFX
//     DeathFXAcid  OBJFX
//     DeathFXElectric  OBJFX
//     DeathFXExplode  OBJFX
//     DeathFXSingularity  OBJFX
//     DeathFXMelee  OBJFX
//     DeathAnimRandom  BOOL
//     DropOnDeath  STR
//     DropOnDeathDivine  STR
//     CorpseLimbLoss  MODE
//     GibLimbs  MODE
//     GibHead  INT
//     GibRightArm  INT
//     GibLeftArm  INT
//     GibRightLeg  INT
//     GibLeftLeg  INT
//     Skin  STR, a skin file of at most 99 characters, which replaces
//           the one the class picks
//
// A section with any other name is a new enemy type, an archetype, and names
// its Base: a class below, or another archetype.  It takes the same keys.  An
// AI of the Base's class with the property Archetype = "<name>" is one.
//
//
// Behavior (BestWeapon to SpawnAlways):
//     BestWeapon     FALSE takes the attack states' change to the best weapon
//                    out (CultistAI, Fanatic, Prophet, GabriellaAI/REV,
//                    OpheliaAI/REV have one)
//     ChaseRun       TRUE: AI_STATE_AttackFar closes in at a run, not a walk
//     AttackWeapon   a weapon, as AIWeapon1 names one, taken up on entering an
//                    attack state
//     NoAltFire      a weapon Prophet never alt-fires standing still
//     ChaseNear      DeathShroud: TRUE closes in only while already within a
//                    third of SeeingDist, the test turned round
//     FadeMax, FadeMin  DeathShroud's alpha, solid and faded (0.9, 0.5)
//     LoopVolume     DeathShroud's and DrudgePriest's looping sound (50, 60)
//     SpawnCooldown, SpawnInterval  DrudgePriest: seconds between summons
//                    (30) and between leeches in one (1.5)
//     SpawnAlways    DrudgePriest: TRUE summons with a leech already in sight
//     Robe           CultistAI: TRUE puts every cultist in the robe (its model,
//                    skin, animations and sounds), whatever the level says
//     DeathSkin<Kind>, DeathFX<Kind>  the corpse's skin, and the effect on the
//                    dying AI, for a death by that damage: Kind is Normal,
//                    Fire, Acid, Electric, Explode, Singularity or Melee; an
//                    effect is an OBJFX_ name without the prefix (SMOKING_3)
//     DeathAnimRandom  TRUE: a death that takes the class's DeathSkin picks a
//                    random death animation
//     DropOnDeath    a class made at the corpse's torso by a death of one of the
//                    kinds above (ZealotAI: at its leg, as it vanishes);
//                    DropOnDeathDivine, a divine ZealotAI's
//     CorpseLimbLoss, GibLimbs  MODE: whether the corpse can lose limbs, and
//                    whether a gibbing throws them; the game's rule (2) is a
//                    Cabal AI or a SoulDrudge
//     GibHead, GibRightArm, GibLeftArm, GibRightLeg, GibLeftLeg  a gib throws
//                    that limb when a roll of 0-100 is above it (80 70 50 70 50)
//     Script         TRUE: the mod's Script.lua hears every AI of the class
//                    (OnCreate, OnDamage, OnDeath, OnTrigger), not only its
//                    archetypes
//
// [Options] takes Trace and Script (TRUE or FALSE; Script is every class's)
// and three difficulty scales, each
// <easy, medium, hard> (insane has none, as in the game):
//     DifficultyDamage     the damage an AI deals (retail <0.25, 1.0, 1.5>)
//     DifficultyHitPoints  its starting hit points (retail <0.25, 1.0, 1.5>)
//     DifficultyArmor      its armor (retail <0.25, 1.0, 1.5>)
// and the death table for every class, before a class's own keys:
//     DeathSkin<Kind>, DeathFX<Kind>  as above (retail: DeathSkinFire is
//                          "skins\enemies\burned.dtx", with a random animation)
//     BulletGib            FALSE: only an explosion (or ALWAYSGIB) bursts a body,
//                          not a 90% hit
//
// The Flags names (AI_Mgr.h's FLAG_):
//    CRAWL JUMP LIMP DODGE LIMBLOSS ALWAYSRECOIL
//    ALWAYSGIB CANASSIST ALWAYSCLEAR NOAMMOCOLLECT NIGHTMAREDEATH NEVERGIB
//
// The classes, one section each.
